articles.summary: We are pleased to share that we have received the first sample of the Calliope™ 3 SQN4530 chip, our new 5G NR eRedCap cellular IoT platform and the third generation of our flagship Calliope chipset family. The SQN4530 is designed to support eRedCap Full Duplex (FD) and Half Duplex (HD) operation, with integrated 4G LTE fallback, enabling devices to seamlessly connect across both next-generation 5G networks and existing 4G deployments.
